components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action of a view: Save, Publish, Add.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.3rem) - 2px); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.105 223.128)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.984 0.019 200.873)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.105 223.128)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.3rem) - 2px); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); border-color: var(--border, oklch(0.923 0.003 48.717)); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0.001 106.424)); color: var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.216 0.006 56.043)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem; width: 16rem; background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.985 0.001 106.423)); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.3rem) - 2px); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); font: 400 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0.001 106.424)); color: var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.216 0.006 56.043)); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); }

components.css: .ds-tree { font-family: var(--font-sans, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-tree-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem 0.375rem calc(0.5rem + var(--depth, 0) * 1.5rem); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.923 0.003 48.717)); transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-tree-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0.001 106.424)) 60%, transparent); } .ds-tree-chevron { display: inline-flex; width: 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.49 0.013 58.071)); transition: transform 120ms ease; } .ds-tree-chevron.is-open { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-tree-title { color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tree-meta { margin-inline-start: auto; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.49 0.013 58.071)); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-tree-row.is-hidden { opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Language Tabs
components.description: Signature: per field language tabs whose dot says filled, falling back or empty.
components.css: .ds-langs { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0.125rem; background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0.001 106.424)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.3rem) - 2px); } .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.3rem) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.49 0.013 58.071)); font: 500 0.625rem/0.875rem var(--font-sans, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lang[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); } .ds-lang:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); } .ds-dot { display: inline-block; width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; margin-inline-start: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.49 0.013 58.071)); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-dot.is-filled { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.105 223.128)); border-color: var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.105 223.128)); } .ds-dot.is-fallback { border-style: dashed; }

components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--success, oklch(0.455 0.125 150)); color: var(--success-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.018 155)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, black 12%, transparent); } .ds-notice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-notice-close { font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; opacity: 0.8; }

keyCharacteristics: Flat by default: no shadows in the default preset, depth from borders and tonal washes.
One accent, used for action and state, never for decoration.
Geist for every text style, headings included; slightly wide tracking everywhere.
Compact, consistent control heights (36px default, 32px small, 28px extra small).
Tokens only: Tailwind's raw palette is removed, so every color comes from a theme token.
Light, dark and system schemes, each user's choice remembered per browser.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: No raw color reaches markup. Tailwind's palette is removed (`--color-*: initial`); a color is a BlatUI token or a `--lynx-*` token defaulting to one. Black and white survive only for overlays and text on solid fills. The `--lynx-mark-*` tokens are the one exception: they hold the logo's own colors.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks where something happens or has happened (an action, focus, a filled value, a drop target). If a screen uses it for decoration, the editor loses the signal.

rules.name: The Wide Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing runs at +0.025em across the interface (`tracking: wide`); only the headline pulls back to neutral. Do not set per element tracking against it.

rules.name: The One Unit Rule
rules.body: Every gap, padding and size is a multiple of the spacing unit, so the spacing preset scales the whole admin at once. Fixed pixel spacing breaks it.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a border or a wash, never by a shadow alone. If turning shadows off would merge two surfaces, the design is wrong.

dos: Do take every color from a token (`bg-background`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-primary`), so presets, client branding and host stylesheets keep working.
Do build new screens from the BlatUI components in `components/ui` and the `blat-*` native classes; patch a copied component only with a comment saying why.
Do keep controls on the 36, 32 and 28px heights and spacing on multiples of the spacing unit.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Stone Rule border or a wash, so the design reads correctly with shadows off.
Do check every new screen in light and dark mode and with a client accent other than Lynx Teal, at WCAG AA contrast.
Do show translation state with the language dot vocabulary (filled, dashed, empty) wherever a value has languages.
donts: Don't use Tailwind's raw palette (`bg-gray-100`, `text-blue-600`); it is removed from the build on purpose.
Don't add new `--lynx-*` tokens for anything BlatUI already has a token for; Lynx tokens exist only for the page tree, the notification bar and the Lynx mark.
Don't recolor the Lynx mark with the accent, stretch it, or show it in an admin the site has branded.
Don't rely on a shadow to separate surfaces or to show state.
Don't use the accent for decoration, illustration or large fills.
Don't hardcode fonts, radii or letter spacing on an element; they are preset dimensions the host app controls.
Don't use the Micro size for anything other than the compact language tabs.
